name: International Protection (Refugee Status / Subsidiary Protection)

requirements.blocker_text: Asylum in Bosnia and Herzegovina runs through a three-body structure: intent to seek asylum is first registered with the Service for Foreigners' Affairs (Sluzba za poslove sa strancima), the substantive application and refugee-status determination is handled by the Sector for Asylum within the Ministry of Security, and post-recognition integration support falls to the Ministry for Human Rights and Refugees. No source reviewed in this build could confirm the statutory processing timeline, detailed rights attached to each protection status, or appeal procedure -- a genuine, disclosed gap rather than an assumed 'standard' process.
requirements.fix_path: Register intent to seek asylum with the Service for Foreigners' Affairs, then pursue the application through the Sector for Asylum, Ministry of Security.

sources.title: UNHCR Help Bosnia and Herzegovina -- three-body asylum structure (Service for Foreigners' Affairs, Sector for Asylum/Ministry of Security, Ministry of Human Rights and Refugees)
